factual_methodology.summary: SlaveVoyages and ILO modern-slavery scope or FAO/Conab/IBGE agrifood series verified with time windows, units, and non-additivity of distinct measures.

counterfactual_review.summary: No fabricated causation: emancipation and agronomy/food access require specified counterfactuals; social impacts and statistical overlap expressly handled.

limitations: Measurement series have different universes and sample methods
